selection.method: sorted simple random sample without replacement from source rows whose own document appears in the clean TF-IDF top-k; attack categories allocated 14 Base Encoding, 13 Reverse Text, and 13 Substitution Ciphers

adaptation: Each selected table is a retrievable document. One pinned BIPIA text attack is appended to its target document for adversarial conditions. Retrieval uses the complete 100-document test corpus. Only attacks with deterministic output-transformation criteria are sampled. This is not an official BIPIA score.
